pattern.description: The cursor selects Working Budget and clicks the toolbar copy action. A new blank row is inserted under it and selected, the rows below snap down, and the right-hand details panel re-renders as the new-version form.
pattern.why_premium: Cause and effect stay visible in one framed view: the click, the new row and the form all land together while the voice-over says 'Let's call this new version'. The viewer never loses the thread of the workflow.

build_hint.gsap: Timeline: tl.to('.cursor', {x: toolbarX, y: toolbarY, duration: 0.35, ease: 'power2.inOut'}).to('.cursor', {scale: 0.9, duration: 0.06, yoyo: true, repeat: 1}). Then Flip the list: Flip.from(state, {duration: 0.25, ease: 'power2.out'}) after inserting the row, and run .fromTo('.new-row', {autoAlpha: 0}, {autoAlpha: 1, duration: 0.2}) at the same time. Finish with .fromTo('.details-form', {autoAlpha: 0, y: 6}, {autoAlpha: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.25, ease: 'power2.out'}, '<').
build_hint.remotion: Interpolate the cursor position with Easing.inOut(Easing.cubic) over about 10 frames. At clickFrame, insert the row and drive translateY for the rows below with spring({config: {damping: 200}}) * rowH. Cross-fade the details panel content with interpolate over 6 frames.
